approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.subtitle: Sensitive actions waiting for a 2FA code or the approval of a second person.
approvals.notFound: This request does not exist or is not visible to you.
approvals.confirmHint: Your access key or agent asked for this action. Confirm it with your 2FA code, then the agent runs it.
approvals.approveCodeHint: Your own 2FA code will be asked next.
approvals.cancelConfirm: Cancel your request? The action will not run.
approvals.confirmedAgentToast: Confirmed: the agent can now run the action (it calls it again).
approvals.approvedToast: Approved: the requester can now run the action.

gate.title: Waiting for approval
gate.pendingHint: This action needs the approval of a second authorised person, who was notified. Nothing has been done yet. Keep this window open to run it as soon as it is approved.
gate.approved: Approved. Run the action now to apply it.
gate.approvedBy: Approved by {{name}}. Run the action now to apply it.
gate.denied: Denied by {{name}}: the action was not run.
gate.expired: This request expired: the action was not run. Do it again to file a new request.
gate.cancelled: Request cancelled: the action was not run.
gate.closeHintReplay: If you close this window, you will be offered to run the action once it is approved.
gate.closeHintRedo: This request carries a secret or a file that is not kept: if you close this window, do the action again once it is approved.

replay.approved: Request #{{id}} was approved. Nothing was done yet.
replay.denied: Request #{{id}} was denied: the action was not run.
replay.expired: Request #{{id}} expired: the action was not run.
replay.cancelled: Request #{{id}} was cancelled: the action was not run.

errors.twoFactorNotEnrolled: This action needs two-factor authentication. Enable it in your profile (authenticator app), then try again.
errors.twoFactorNotEnrolledSso: This action needs two-factor authentication. Enable it on your Obligate account (or an authenticator app in your profile here), then try again.
errors.noEligibleApprover: This action needs the approval of a second authorised person with two-factor authentication, and there is none. Ask an administrator to add one.
errors.approvalMismatch: This approval was given for other parameters: the action was not run. Send it again to file a new request.
errors.tooManyPendingActions: Too many requests are waiting for a decision. Wait for them, or cancel some in Approvals.
errors.stepUpLocked: Too many wrong codes. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.restrictionsLockout: This change would lock the matrix: nobody else could approve its next change. Add a second administrator with two-factor authentication first, or keep « Change this matrix » at 2FA.
errors.notEligibleApprover: You may no longer approve this action (your rights changed).
errors.keyCannotDecide: An access key can never confirm, approve or deny a request.
